text: Pare-DSH（DSH 插件，Windows 客户端）：把 Pare 磁盘调查和清理工具接入 DSH agent。插件启动固定版本的 Pare 核心进程，并注册扫描、只读调查、清理预览、执行、隔离区查看、撤销和永久清除等工具；执行清理、撤销、清除及读取敏感文件前会请求用户逐次批准。清理可先预览并将文件移入可恢复隔离区，之后可恢复或永久删除。适合希望在 DSH 中检查本机磁盘占用并处理可识别垃圾文件的 Windows 用户。首次启动需访问 GitHub 下载固定核心；无需 API Key。

Pare-DSH brings Windows disk scans and cleanup tools to the DSH agent. It registers investigation, cleanup preview, quarantine, restore, and purge tools, with user approval for changes and sensitive reads. First startup downloads its pinned core from GitHub.
想让 DSH 帮我看看 Windows 磁盘空间都被什么占了。
有没有办法先扫描文件夹，再找出大文件和重复占用？
我想在 DSH 里准备清理方案，确认后再处理文件。
清理误操作后，能不能把隔离的文件恢复回去？
Can DSH help me investigate what is taking up space on my Windows drive?
I want to review a cleanup plan, quarantine files, and restore them if needed.
如何先查看清理会影响哪些路径，再决定是否执行？
How can I inspect disk waste from my Windows computer in a DSH session?
Pare-DSH 的功能「磁盘扫描」：调用 pare_scan 扫描指定的 Windows 盘符或文件夹，并返回扫描完整性、文件与目录数量和占用空间摘要；扫描建立后续调查工具使用的索引。
Pare-DSH 的功能「只读调查」：先运行扫描，再调用 Pare 核心提供的 pare_ 调查工具检查目录、较大文件、重复文件或诊断信息，返回调查结果供 DSH 汇总。
Pare-DSH 的功能「审批后清理」：pare_prepare_cleanup 根据路径或支持的动作模板生成清理预览；用户批准后 pare_execute 才执行，文件可移入隔离区。
Pare-DSH 的功能「恢复或清除隔离批次」：查看本机隔离批次，可经用户批准将批次恢复到原位置，或永久清除以释放空间。
Pare-DSH 使用时会把调查得到的路径和文件名返回给模型及其服务商；敏感文件内容只有经用户批准读取后才会发送给模型服务商。
Pare-DSH 首次启动会从固定 GitHub 发布地址下载 Windows 核心到用户本地目录并校验 SHA-256；需要首次启动时可访问 GitHub。

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Introduction：Pare-DSH brings [Pare](https://github.com/DRAG0NM/Pare)'s AI disk investigation into DeepSeek Harness (DSH). The DSH agent investigates this machine's disk waste with Pare's read-only tools and prepares a cleanup. The scanning, investigation and cleanup are all done by the separate Pare core; the plugin only starts the core, registers the tools and asks for approval.

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Introduction：Nothing changes until you approve it in DSH's own approval prompt, and files are moved into a reversible quarantine rather than deleted.

Recorded in a real DSH session on a demo folder.

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Install：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @drag0nm/pare-dsh
```

Restart the profile (for example `dsh web`). No configuration is needed. On first start the plugin downloads the pinned Pare core and verifies it (see [The pinned core](#the-pinned-core)).

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · A closer look：

Approval — the prompt lists the exact files before anything moves.
Result — the agent's report after the cleanup, with what was kept and why.

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Tools：The plugin starts a long-lived `pare serve` process (protocol `pare.serve/1`, line-delimited JSON over stdio) and registers these tools. The scan index lives in that process, so run `pare_scan` before the investigation tools.

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Tools：| Tool | What it does | Needs approval |
|---|---|:---:|
| `pare_scan` | Read-only scan of a drive or folder; keeps the index in the core process | No |
| `pare_scan_overview`, `pare_list_dir`, `pare_find_large_files`, `pare_same_size_files`, `pare_breakdown`, `pare_file_head`, `pare_read_text`, `pare_path_info`, `pare_installed_programs`, `pare_running_processes`, `pare_run_diagnostic` | Read-only investigation tools provided by the core. The list is requested from the core at startup (`hello`) and follows the core version | No |
| `pare_read_sensitive` | Reads files Pare marks as sensitive (keys, `.env`, browser login data, credential stores) | Yes, every time |
| `pare_prepare_cleanup` | Registers paths for quarantine and supported action templates, and returns a cleanup id. Nothing changes yet | No |
| `pare_execute` | Executes a prepared cleanup by id | Yes |
| `pare_list_quarantine` | Lists quarantine batches on local drives and their contents | No |
| `pare_undo` | Restores a quarantine batch to its original location, never overwriting a file that has taken the original path | Yes |
| `pare_purge` | Permanently deletes a quarantine batch to f
@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Tools：The plugin offers no raw shell commands. DSH's own bash tool has its own approval.

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Approval and safety：The plugin listens to DSH's `tools/pre-execute` and answers `{kind: 'ask'}` for `pare_execute`, `pare_undo`, `pare_purge` and `pare_read_sensitive`. DSH asks you through its own approval service. Only a one-time `allowed-once` lets the call through; if you reject, cancel, or nobody is available to answer, the call is denied (fail closed). Every question is recorded in the session audit log.

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Approval and safety：- The approval prompt for `pare_execute` is built from the plan the plugin stored, listing the exact paths and template commands. It is not taken from the model's description.
- Unknown, expired and pre-rescan cleanup ids are denied without asking. A cleanup id can be executed at most once.
- Cancelling a running call stops the core process; the next call starts a new one, and `pare_scan` must be run again.

The core enforces its own checks, independent of the host:

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Approval and safety：- Protected locations are always refused.
- Every item carries evidence produced by `BuildSelected`.
- Before each file is moved, the executor re-checks its identity, whether it changed, and whether it is in use.
- Action templates are validated, the preview digest must match, and a preview expires after 30 minutes.
- The preview is marked as used before execution starts.
- `undo` and `purge` accept only manifests inside the Pare quarantine.

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Approval and safety：Privacy: investigation tools return paths and file names to the model (and its provider). The contents of sensitive files require your approval on every read.

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · The pinned core：The `pareCore` entry in `package.json` pins the core for this plugin version: version 0.4.0, the download URL (the `pare-0.4.0-win-x64.exe` asset of the `v0.4.0` release of `DRAG0NM/Pare`) and its SHA-256, `23a09ed98b24642e80c1ee83d8a7464e6fa0df2ac1a1d6e078cd5882672001fb`.

When neither `parePath` nor `PARE_CORE_PATH` is set:

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · The pinned core：- The plugin uses `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Pare\core\pare-0.4.0.exe`, stored per user outside the plugin directory so reinstalling or upgrading the plugin does not lose it. If the file is missing, it is downloaded from the pinned URL: first with `curl.exe` from System32 (which honors `HTTPS_PROXY`), then, if that fails, with PowerShell's `Invoke-WebRequest` (which uses the Windows system proxy).
- The SHA-256 is verified after the download. The file is kept only if it matches; a mismatching download is deleted.
- The hash is verified again on every start and before every core process start. If the file has been modified, the plugin refuses to run (it never replaces it automatically) and the error says to delete the file so it is downloaded again.
- The version reported by `hello` must equal the pinned version; otherwise the plugin refuses it and registers no investigation tools.
- On some machines `AppData\Local` is EFS-encrypted and a rename within the directory is rejected (EXDEV), or an antivirus briefly holds the file. The plugin retries for a few seconds, then falls back to copying and deleting the temporary file; the final file must pass the

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Requirements：- Windows.
- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` (Cordis `4.0.5`). Harness is still a developer preview and its interfaces may change incompatibly; Pare-DSH pins the peer version to the tool interface it was verified against, so re-test before upgrading.
- Node.js 22.19 or newer (DSH's own requirement).
- Access to GitHub on first start, to download the pinned core.

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Build from source：```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm check
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

Verified end to end in DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, including reject, allow, undo and purge, and installing from npm.

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Introduction：

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · Introduction：Pare-DSH 把 [Pare](https://github.com/DRAG0NM/Pare) 的 AI 磁盘调查带进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）。DSH 里的智能体用 Pare 的只读工具调查这台电脑上的磁盘浪费，并准备好清理方案。扫描、调查和清理都由独立的 Pare 核心完成；插件只负责启动核心、注册工具和发起审批。 在你于 DSH 自己的审批提示里批准之前，什么都不会改动；文件会被移入可撤回的隔离区，而不是直接删除。

在真实的 DSH 会话中对演示文件夹录制。

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · 安装：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @drag0nm/pare-dsh
```

重启该 profile（例如 `dsh web`）即可。不需要任何配置。首次启动时，插件会下载固定版本的 Pare 核心并校验（见[固定版本的核心](#固定版本的核心)）。

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · 细看：

审批 —— 提示在任何文件移动之前列出确切的文件。
结果 —— 清理后智能体的报告，说明保留了什么以及原因。
@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · 工具：插件启动一个常驻的 `pare serve` 进程（协议 `pare.serve/1`，通过标准输入输出收发按行分隔的 JSON），并注册下列工具。扫描索引保存在这个进程里，所以调查类工具要先调用 `pare_scan`。

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · 工具：| 工具 | 作用 | 需要批准 |
|---|---|:---:|
| `pare_scan` | 只读扫描一个盘或目录，在核心进程里保留索引 | 否 |
| `pare_scan_overview`、`pare_list_dir`、`pare_find_large_files`、`pare_same_size_files`、`pare_breakdown`、`pare_file_head`、`pare_read_text`、`pare_path_info`、`pare_installed_programs`、`pare_running_processes`、`pare_run_diagnostic` | 核心提供的只读调查工具。列表在插件启动时向核心询问（`hello`），随核心版本变化 | 否 |
| `pare_read_sensitive` | 读取被 Pare 标为敏感的文件内容（密钥、`.env`、浏览器登录数据、凭据库） | 是，每次 |
| `pare_prepare_cleanup` | 登记要移入隔离区的路径和受支持的动作模板，返回清理 id。此时不改动任何东西 | 否 |
| `pare_execute` | 按 id 执行一份已准备的清理 | 是 |
| `pare_list_quarantine` | 列出本地盘上的隔离批次及其内容 | 否 |
| `pare_undo` | 把一个隔离批次恢复到原位置，不覆盖已占用原路径的文件 | 是 |
| `pare_purge` | 永久删除一个隔离批次以释放空间，无法恢复 | 是 |
@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · 工具：插件不提供原始 shell 命令。DSH 自带的 bash 工具有它自己的审批。

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · 审批与安全：插件监听 DSH 的 `tools/pre-execute`，对 `pare_execute`、`pare_undo`、`pare_purge` 和 `pare_read_sensitive` 返回 `{kind: 'ask'}`。DSH 通过自己的审批服务询问你：只有一次性的 `allowed-once` 才会放行；你拒绝、取消，或没有可回答的一方时，调用一律被拒绝（失败即关闭）。每次询问都记入会话审计日志。

- `pare_execute` 的审批提示由插件保存的方案生成，列出确切的路径和模板命令，不取自模型的描述。
- 未知、已过期以及重新扫描之前的清理 id 会被直接拒绝，不会弹出询问。一个清理 id 最多执行一次。
- 取消一个正在运行的调用会停止核心进程；下一次调用会启动新进程，需要重新运行 `pare_scan`。

核心一侧还有独立的检查，不依赖宿主：

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · 审批与安全：- 受保护的位置一律拒绝。
- 每个条目都带 `BuildSelected` 生成的证据。
- 执行器在移动每个文件之前，重新检查文件身份、是否被改动、是否被占用。
- 动作模板经过校验；预览的 digest 必须匹配；预览 30 分钟后过期。
- 执行开始前先把预览标记为已使用。
- `undo` 和 `purge` 只接受 Pare 隔离区内的清单。

隐私：调查工具会把路径和文件名返回给模型（以及它的服务商）。敏感文件的内容每次读取都要经过你的批准。

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · 固定版本的核心：`package.json` 的 `pareCore` 固定了本插件版本使用的核心：版本 0.4.0、下载地址（GitHub `DRAG0NM/Pare` 的 `v0.4.0` 发布资产 `pare-0.4.0-win-x64.exe`）和 SHA-256 `23a09ed98b24642e80c1ee83d8a7464e6fa0df2ac1a1d6e078cd5882672001fb`。

未设置 `parePath` 和 `PARE_CORE_PATH` 时：

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · 固定版本的核心：- 插件使用 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Pare\core\pare-0.4.0.exe`（按用户保存在插件目录之外，重装或升级插件不会丢失）。文件不存在就按固定地址下载：先用 System32 里的 `curl.exe`（遵循 `HTTPS_PROXY`），失败再用 PowerShell 的 `Invoke-WebRequest`（使用 Windows 系统代理）。
- 下载完成后校验 SHA-256，匹配才保留；不匹配的下载文件会被删除。
- 之后每次启动，以及每次启动核心进程之前，都会再次校验哈希。文件被改动时插件拒绝运行（不会自动替换），错误信息会提示删除该文件以重新下载。
- `hello` 返回的版本必须等于固定版本，否则插件拒绝使用，不注册任何调查工具。
- 某些机器上 `AppData\Local` 启用了 EFS 加密，同目录内的重命名会被拒绝（EXDEV）；文件被杀毒软件短暂占用时也会拒绝。插件会重试几秒，仍不行就改为复制后删除临时文件，最终文件同样要通过哈希校验。

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · 环境要求：- Windows。
- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`（Cordis `4.0.5`）。Harness 目前仍是 developer preview，接口可能发生不兼容变化；Pare-DSH 把 peer 版本固定在验证过的工具接口上，升级前需先重新测试。
- Node.js 22.19 或更新版本（DSH 自身的要求）。
- 首次启动时需要能访问 GitHub，以下载固定版本的核心。

@drag0nm/pare-dsh README · 从源码构建：```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm check
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```
